- Basic context signals are present. Verify their values and reproducibility manually.

## Suggested investigation order
1. Identify the refusing host and port from sanitized logs; a refused TCP connection happens before API-key validation.
2. Check service health, container DNS/ports, and whether localhost refers to the wrong container.
3. Compare the previous and current Dify/plugin-daemon versions, release notes and effective environment configuration.
